methodology.sourceTimeframe: Yahoo 1m only; exact 5m bars aggregated from the same minute timeline
methodology.breakoutDefinition: Closed 5m candle crosses the previous 12-bar high/low
methodology.breakoutEntry: Next available 1m open after the 5m breakout closes
methodology.retestEntry: Next 1m open after a touch and close beyond the level within three minutes
methodology.optionModel: Nearest listed strike theoretical 0DTE premium with 3% half-spread; no historical option quotes
methodology.featureTiming: 1m ignition and pre-break 5m features end before the breakout candle; acceptance uses the closed breakout candle
methodology.split: Sessions before 2026-09-03 train; 2026-09-03 and later untouched chronological holdout
methodology.tradingViewJoin: Real stored 5m snapshot at or before the pre-break candle and no older than 15 minutes
